page.layout: One printed page, single text column of running text with numbered paragraphs (XLVIII, XLIX, L) and centred short lines; marginal references set in italics within the text lines; closing lines centred at foot. Page number 514 at top right corner, written by hand, not printed text, so not transcribed as page number.

main_text.p: viam acquisitionis vel inventionis ratiocinatio tanquam ab immobili termino, ad quietum procedit, & in via judicii ad prima illa principia, resolvendo revertitur, Jope ac fundamine contemplatur Veritate, & Verum quod intellectûs, cujus præcipuus civis est, terminus exiftit. Arist. 2. Metaph. c. 1. 2. poft. Anal. cap. 19. Thom. 1. part. S. Th. quæft. 16. art. 1.
XLVIII. Practicus est, cujus intellectio & ratiocinatio propter opus, ac Bonum efficiendum fuscipitur.

XLVIII. Circa Objectum versatur tale; quod aliter se habere poteft, & à voluntate humana dependet. Notitiam practicam, quæ poft cognitionem ulteriorem, ad quam ordinata eft, operationem exigit, producit.

XLIX. Conducit autem operatio illa practica vel ad mores hominum, unde Moralis dicitur, innixa principio Legis naturæ, & recto rationis dictamini, unde Assensus ortum accipit: vel è mente factiva emanat, quæ dependentia nomen eiactionis Artificialis indit.

L. Et hæc tandem omnia intellectui infunt, vel liberè se habenti, remque aut certò scienti, aut dubitandi opinantive, ac ob infirmitatem accidentem labascenti: Vel strictè, dum intellectioni, alienæ propriæve, præteritæ tamen intentus, cogitata resolvit ac recognoscit.
DEO TRINO, ET UNI, LAUS, HONOR ET GLORIA.

page.notes: Printed text is set in long s form; the stroke-like marks on the left edge are show-through/fold and not transcribed. Italic references in the first paragraph are printed in the text line. Some words in the scan are faint or blurred (e.g. "Jope", "Assensus", "factiva") and may need checking. The "XLVIII." heading in the second paragraph is a numbered thesis and is not a true heading; it is marked as a head here only because of its position, and the third paragraph's numeral reads XLVIII as printed in the scan, probably XLIX-type error left as printed.
